summary: Enhance your skills with our AutoCAD Civil 3D Training Course. Learn the ins and outs of this powerful software for civil engineering projects.
lede: Civil 3D training helps CAD and civil design professionals turn survey information into coordinated infrastructure models. Participants practise validating survey data and terrain surfaces, designing alignments, profiles and corridors, coordinating gravity or pressure networks, and producing quantities and plan-profile sheets with data shortcuts and repeatable automation workflows.
audienceIntro: AutoCAD Civil 3D Training suits professionals who already work with CAD or civil design information and need stronger control of model-based production. Each role below connects Civil 3D tools to a specific responsibility in infrastructure delivery.
prerequisites: You should have working experience with AutoCAD drafting and basic civil engineering or surveying terminology. Prior exposure to Civil 3D surfaces, alignments, profiles, or networks is recommended, but the course begins with a structured project setup review. No programming experience is required for completion. Dynamo for Civil 3D is introduced through guided operational exercises rather than technical software development. You will need a laptop capable of running the current supported Autodesk Civil 3D release used by your delivery team, subject to software licensing arrangements. Training datasets and exercise templates can be provided for the facilitated labs.
